final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, s.optvolrt AS optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), c AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS a FROM j GROUP BY transref, tradekind), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM c), d AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.a, c.a - b.base AS dev FROM c, b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL), t AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(dev) AS ad FROM d GROUP BY tradekind), k AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.a, d.dev, d.dev - t.ad AS ex FROM d JOIN t ON d.tradekind = t.tradekind WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL AND d.dev > t.ad) SELECT tradekind, AVG(a) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(ex) AS avg_excess FROM k GROUP BY tradekind
